Class FrameType

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.FrameType
public final class FrameType extends Object
The FrameType type holds the byte that names what a frame contains. The MSG byte is 1. The POLICY byte is 2. The TELEM byte is 3. The ACL byte is 4. The CONT byte is 5. A message writer passes MSG. This type does not write a frame itself. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#FrameType roux-v1.md
